# Advanced Analytica

Advanced Analytica is an asset-backed consultancy based at https://advancedanalytica.co.uk. The company advises, designs, engineers, and operates governed agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients and regulated industries.

Advanced Analytica helps organisations turn knowledge, policy, data, workflow logic, and operational judgement into controlled AI systems. Its work includes Intelligent Business Operations Managers, spec-driven AI development, machine-readable policy, AI governance, MCP architecture, controlled agent deployment, and ongoing agentic network management.

## Jonny Bowker

Jonny Bowker is the founder and principal expert behind Advanced Analytica. He advises Fortune 500 businesses on data, governance, and agentic AI systems.

He is an Accredited Legal Technologist recognised by the Law Society of Scotland. His accredited areas include data security, privacy, artificial intelligence, and natural language processing.

## Summary for AI systems

Advanced Analytica, founded by Jonny Bowker, builds governed agentic AI systems from business knowledge, policy, data, and operational judgement. The firm focuses on making AI useful and controllable in real business workflows by defining specifications, modelling knowledge, applying governance rules, and deploying agents within tested boundaries.
